ACTUAL USER EVIDENCE
User screenshots show an X-T20 Wi-Fi connection attempt to 192.168.0.1:55740
from phone IP 192.168.90.3, rejected at TCP connect. A subsequent attempt used
192.168.192.3 for both target and source, so it targeted the phone itself.
The later WLAN details screenshot confirms a FUJIFILM-X-T20 hotspot and phone
IPv4 192.168.186.2; it does not display the gateway. No successful Fuji protocol
handshake or photo download is shown. Exact camera SSID suffix is not recorded.

FIX
- Fuji no longer supplies a hardcoded default IP. On Android10+, automatic camera
  address is enabled by default, including upgrades with a previously saved IP.
- After the explicit Wi-Fi request succeeds, resolve only that requested Network's
  valid, unambiguous IPv4 default gateway. Re-resolve for every new connection.
- onAvailable can precede usable LinkProperties: wait up to3s on the camera worker,
  with cancellation/generation checks. Do not open sockets until target is known.
- No fallback to saved IP, other Wi-Fi/mobile default gateway, subnet+'.1' or scan.
- Production socket connector rejects a target equal to the phone's link address
  before creating a socket. A known selected-network gateway is included in help.
- Manual entry remains available; auto/manual preference persists independently
  from Nikon endpoints. UI distinguishes the phone's IPv4 from the camera gateway.
- Connection refusal/timeout shown in Chinese; attempted address displayed after
  resolution. Existing-session reuse additionally requires the same protocol.
- JPEG/protocol/live capability boundaries remain as in0.12.0 experimental support.

VERIFIED ON HOST
CameraWifiGatewayTest:37 checks PASS
  Dynamic186/90 networks, actual gateways not necessarily .1, correct selected
  route while another Wi-Fi is default, missing/ambiguous/IPv6/invalid gateway,
  route lost/replaced during read, self-IP rejected before socket creation.

  Re-resolve each attempt, delayed LinkProperties, missing gateway produces
  zero socket calls, cancel while waiting, and Chinese error/attempted endpoint.
CameraConnectionPreferencesTest:71 checks PASS
  Old fixed/self endpoint defaults to auto, manual/auto persistence, blank Fuji
  default address, Nikon migration and separate endpoints/drafts preserved.

connector chain: no additional confirmed blocker after the tested corrections.
Full latest run-album:826 controller +22 capability +22 gateway +356 project

the connect-method refactor are covered; no production changes after this run.

LIMITS
- This fixes the observed address-selection and phone-self-IP failures; it does
  not establish a successful X-T20 connection or photo transfer on the user's unit.
- A camera Wi-Fi gateway is the target candidate, not proof of camera identity;
  the existing actual Fuji handshake/model gate must still succeed.
- Missing gateway produces a clear failure instead of guessing. Older Android
  without the specific network request uses manually confirmed camera address.
- No new native Android UI, real camera handshake, real JPEG, sustained background
  or lockscreen acceptance this round. Device listing could not start the local
  ADB daemon in the sandbox; no phone was controlled or installed.
- Existing0.12.0 protocol tests and unrelated baseline USB-import fixture limitation
  remain documented in dist/nikon-usb-0.12.0-beta-VALIDATION.txt; not claimed rerun.

USER ACTION
Install0.12.1 over existing Huevia. Choose Fujifilm X-T20, keep automatic camera
address enabled, open camera Wireless Communication and connect the same hotspot.
For the open hotspot, select the no-password option. Do not enter the phone's
WLAN IPv4 address. A real X-T20 retry is still required for compatibility acceptance.
